CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content was provided.

COD.rationale: Identified content (C), organization/presentation (O) and a separate origin/status (D) are present for current items, but their scopes/bindings are not all unambiguously aligned to a single compatible scope/value in the report text.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to an identified content's organization/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content positions assigned the attribute 'red' for a current item.

D.rationale: The report separately attributes an 'origin' / record_status object to the identified content, distinguishing its identity from its access/origin status.

O.rationale: The text states how the grid/content is presented (row/column orientation) and the content lists show organized spatial patterns.
